app.name: Foldex
close.title: Keep Foldex running?
close.text:
In the tray, the Quick panel and watch folders keep working.
You can change this later in Settings → General.
home.title: Home
home.drop_hint: Or hold {0} while dragging files in Explorer. The Quick panel opens at your cursor.
home.drop_hint_macos: Or hold {0} while dragging files in Finder. The Quick panel opens at your cursor.
home.drop_hint_linux: Or hold {0} while dragging files in your file manager. The Quick panel opens at your cursor.
home.accessibility_needed:
To open the Quick panel by dragging with ⌥ Option, allow Foldex under Accessibility.
It works as soon as you switch it on.
home.elevated:
Foldex is running as administrator, so Explorer can't drop files on it or use its menu.
The shortcut can't read Explorer's selection either.
Restart Foldex without administrator rights to fix this.
home.elevated_restart_failed:
Foldex couldn't restart itself.
Quit Foldex from the tray, then start it again.
elevation.notice_text:
Explorer can't drop files on Foldex or use its menu while it runs this way.
Restart it without administrator rights.
startup.elevated_other:
Another Foldex is running as administrator.
Explorer can't hand files to it.
Quit Foldex from the tray, then start it again.
startup.no_answer:
Foldex is running but didn't answer.
If it runs as administrator, quit it from the tray and start it again.
home.recent_empty: Your converted files will show up here.
donut.group_empty: No presets left in this group. Edit it in Settings → Quick panel
donut.empty: Add actions in Settings → Quick panel
format_request.notice_text:
Tell us which format you need.
Requests decide what Foldex supports next.
Encrypted or copy-protected (DRM) files can't be converted, whatever the format.
error.no_route: No engine can do this conversion
error.cannot_turn: Rotate and flip work on images only
error.too_many_frames: Too many frames to save as pictures, raise "Every Nth frame"
error.not_enough_space: Not enough free disk space for the pictures
error.rhwp_timeout: rhwp couldn't finish this long document in time
error.rhwp_timeout_calibre: rhwp couldn't finish this long document in time. For an e-book, move Calibre above the HWPX writer in Settings → Engines, and Calibre makes the PDF much faster
notice.pdf_not_smaller: Couldn't make it smaller, so it was copied as it is
engine.reason.needs_package: Needs {0}. Install it in Settings → Engines
engine.magick.description:
JPG, PNG, WEBP, AVIF, HEIC, TIFF, GIF, APNG, PSD, camera RAW and more.
Quality, size and DPI follow your preset.
engine.pdfium.description: Renders PDF pages to PNG, JPG and TIFF (also multi-page TIFF and GIF) at the preset's resolution.
engine.pdfsharp.description:
Makes PDFs from images and merges, splits or cuts page ranges out of PDFs.
Also makes PDFs smaller by scaling down their pictures.
engine.rhwp.description:
Renders HWP/HWPX to PDF and converts HWP ↔ HWPX.
It also draws documents that reach PDF through HWPX (DOCX, XLSX, PPTX, e-books…).
engine.unhwp.description: Extracts text, Markdown and HTML from HWP and HWPX.
engine.spreadsheet.description:
XLSX, XLS, ODS, CSV and TSV into each other (XLS is read only).
One CSV per sheet.
engine.ooxml.description:
Macro-enabled files and templates (DOCM, XLSM, PPTM, DOTX…) ↔ DOCX, XLSX, PPTX.
Macros are removed.
engine.hwpx-writer.description:
Writes HWPX from Word, Excel, PowerPoint, PDF, HTML, e-books and Markdown.
The first step of turning documents into PDF without Office.
engine.docx-writer.description: Writes Word documents (DOCX) from PDF, HWP/HWPX, Markdown, HTML, spreadsheets, slides and e-books.
engine.pdf-text.description: Extracts the text of PDFs in reading order, also from two-column pages (no OCR for scans).
engine.pdf-slides.description: Turns PDFs into PowerPoint slides: each page becomes a picture on its own slide (looks like the PDF, not editable), with the page text in the speaker notes.
engine.email.description:
E-mails (EML, Outlook MSG) to HTML and text with sender, recipients and date, pictures included; attachments into a ZIP.
MSG to EML.
engine.data.description:
JSON, JSON Lines, YAML, TOML, XML and CSV into each other.
vCard contacts to CSV and back.
Comments are dropped. CSV holds tables only.
engine.vector.description: SVG and SVGZ to vector PDF, images and DXF; pictures traced into SVG; Illustrator files saved with PDF content.
engine.icns.description: macOS app icons (ICNS) from and to images.
engine.font.description: Fonts: TTF, OTF, WOFF, WOFF2 and EOT into each other.
engine.cad.description: AutoCAD drawings: DWG ↔ DXF, and both to PDF, SVG and PNG.
engine.model3d.description: 3D models: GLB, glTF, STL, OBJ, 3MF and PLY into each other, and a PNG preview.
engine.archive.description: Extracts ZIP, 7Z, RAR, TAR, ISO and more, and packs ZIP, 7Z or TAR.GZ (7-Zip).
engine.ebook.description:
EPUB, MOBI, AZW3, FB2 and comics (CBZ, CBR) to PDF, EPUB, DOCX and text.
Also documents to EPUB, EPUB to KEPUB for Kobo and PDF to CBZ.
engine.subtitle.description:
Subtitles: SRT, ASS/SSA, WebVTT, SAMI (SMI), LRC, TTML, MicroDVD and SCC into each other, saved as UTF-8.
Korean SMI and SRT files in CP949 / EUC-KR read correctly.
engine.ffmpeg.description:
Video and audio: MP4, MOV, MKV, WEBM, MP3, M4A, WAV, FLAC and more.
Also extracts sound and subtitles, makes GIF and APNG animations and saves images as HEIC.
engine.pandoc.description:
Markdown and HTML ↔ ODT and RTF, DOCX → Markdown
reStructuredText, LaTeX, Org, AsciiDoc, Typst, MediaWiki, DocBook, Jupyter and more ↔ Markdown, HTML, DOCX and ODT
Markdown and Org → PPTX slides
engine.ghostscript.description: EPS, PostScript and older Illustrator files to PDF and images; PDF to EPS and PS.
engine.calibre.description:
Rare e-book formats (LIT, LRF, CHM, PDB, RB…) and Kindle output (MOBI, AZW3).
Above the HWPX writer, it also makes the PDFs of e-books (much faster for long books).
engine.libreoffice.description:
Reads older and less common formats: DOC, PPT, Pages, Keynote, Numbers, WordPerfect, ClarisWorks, Publisher, Visio…
Also saves as DOC, XLS, PPT, ODT, ODP, OpenDocument templates and EMF.

general.title: General
general.start_with_system: Start Foldex when I sign in
general.context_menu: Show “Convert with Foldex” in the Explorer context menu
general.context_menu_macos: Show “Convert with Foldex” when you right-click files in Finder
general.context_menu_linux: Add “Convert with Foldex” to the file manager
general.integration_macos:
Finder shows it in the right-click menu (under Quick Actions or Services when the menu is long).
Keep Foldex in Applications.
general.integration_linux:
Adds file actions to Thunar, Nautilus, Nemo and Dolphin.
To change Thunar's shortcut, close Thunar first and reopen it afterwards.
general.modern_menu_hint:
On Windows 11 this entry is under “Show more options”.
It can also go in the main menu (Windows asks for administrator permission once).
general.modern_menu_on: “Convert with Foldex” is in the main Windows 11 menu.
general.modern_menu_outdated:
The main-menu entry belongs to an older or moved copy of Foldex.
Add it again to update it.
general.modern_menu_cancelled: Cancelled. The entry stays under “Show more options”.
general.modern_menu_failed: Windows did not add the entry: {0}
general.modern_menu_remove_failed: Windows did not remove the entry: {0}
general.default_output_hint:
Presets set to “Default save location” save here.
A preset with its own location keeps it.
general.keep_dates: Keep the original file dates for every conversion
general.keep_dates_hint:
Converted files keep the original's created and modified dates, with every preset.
Off: only presets with "Keep the original file dates" do it.
general.close.Tray: Keep Foldex running in the tray
general.no_history: Don't keep a history of recent conversions
update.notice_text: Press Update and Foldex downloads and installs the new version. Your settings are kept.
update.notice_text_portable:
This is the portable version.
Download the new zip and unpack it over this folder. Your settings are kept.
update.installing: The installer is running. Foldex starts again when it is done.
update.failed: Couldn't update automatically. Download the new version from the Foldex releases page.
update.failed_alert:
Couldn't download the update.
Press OK to open the Foldex releases page and download the new version there.
update.cancelled: Update cancelled. Press Update again to install it.
update.level_hint.Required: Fixes problems that affect your files. Please update.
update.level_hint.Optional: New features. Update whenever you like.
general.reset_confirm: Replace all presets and toolbar profiles with the defaults?
triggers.title: Shortcuts
triggers.description: Choose how the Quick panel opens. You can add as many gestures as you like.
triggers.macos_permissions:
Allow Foldex in System Settings > Privacy & Security > Accessibility.
Finder also asks for Automation permission the first time you use a selection shortcut.
triggers.linux_x11:
Drag gestures work on X11.
With file manager integration on, the first keyboard shortcut runs Thunar's Foldex action (reopen Thunar after changing it).
Hold gestures and shortcuts in other file managers aren't available. Use the Foldex menu or the drop zone.
triggers.linux_wayland:
Gestures that follow the cursor aren't available on Wayland.
Use an X11 session, or convert with the file manager menu and the drop zone.
Thunar can use the first keyboard shortcut after it restarts.
triggers.hook_stopped:
Global input detection is stopped.
File manager actions and the drop zone remain available.
triggers.hook_linux_backend:
Gestures couldn't start because the X11 input libraries didn't load.
Use an X11 session and install libxtst6 and libxt6 (Ubuntu/Debian: sudo apt install libxtst6 libxt6), then retry.
File manager actions and the drop zone remain available.
triggers.excluded_hint: Type an app name and press Enter, e.g. photoshop
triggers.excluded_none_running: No other app has a window open.
triggers.excluded_note: Gestures and shortcuts do nothing while the pointer is over these apps.
toolbar.title: Quick panel
toolbar.name: Name
toolbar.hint_add: Drag a chip onto the panel to add it
toolbar.hint_remove: Drag a slice back here to remove it
toolbar.hint_reorder: Drag slices onto each other to reorder
toolbar.hint_edit: Right-click a slice or use ✎ to edit
toolbar.max_reached: The panel holds up to {0} actions

group.empty: No presets yet. Add some below.
group.full: A group holds up to {0} presets.

toolbar.ext_none: No extensions yet. This profile is only used once you add some.
toolbar.ext_invalid: “{0}” isn't a file extension (e.g. jpg or tar.gz).
toolbar.ext_claimed_first: {0}: also in “{1}”, which comes first in the list, so these files still open “{1}”.

toolbar.mixed_locked: Foldex needs at least one profile for mixed selections, so this one stays.

toolbar.mixed_shadowed:

Check some extensions to use this profile.
toolbar.mixed_covered: “{0}” comes first and allows every extension checked here, so this profile is never used.
toolbar.mixed_others_self: No mixed profile is left with nothing checked, so this one is also used for every other mix.
presets.title: Presets
presets.name: Name
presets.keep_color_profile_hint:
Available when metadata is removed.
Without it, wide-gamut photos (Display P3 from phones) can look washed out.
presets.remove_background_hint:
Makes a plain background transparent: the paper behind a signature or stamp, the backdrop of a logo.
The colour along the edge counts as background, so leave some paper around the artwork.
JPG has no transparency and gets the colour below. Not for photos of people.
presets.background_tolerance_hint:
Higher removes more, like shaded paper or smudges. Too high thins light strokes.
To keep a light fill inside an outline, turn on "Keep enclosed areas".
presets.keep_enclosed_background_hint:
Removes only the background touching the edge, so the white inside a logo stays.
Leave off for handwriting (it would keep the paper inside letters like "o").
presets.multipage_tiff: Put every file into one multi-page TIFF
presets.multipage_tiff_hint:
Each image and each PDF or TIFF page becomes a page, in order.
One PDF is enough for a multi-page TIFF.
presets.save_every_frame: Save every frame of a video
presets.save_every_frame_hint:
A video becomes a folder with a picture of each frame instead of one still frame.
A long video gives many files.
presets.frame_estimate: One minute of 30 fps video gives {0} pictures, at most {1} per video.
presets.merge: Merge all files into one PDF
presets.pdf_compression_hint:
Pictures are scaled down and saved as JPEG.
Text, fonts and drawings stay as they are.
If the result isn't smaller, the original is kept.
presets.pdf_ghostscript_hint:
Often smaller, but it rewrites the whole file.
The smallest result is kept.
presets.combine_pages_hint:
Puts all pages one under another in a single image.
Very long results are scaled to the format's limit (JPG 65,500 px, WebP 16,383 px).
presets.combine_pages: Stack the pages into one tall image (when a PDF is converted)
presets.trim_page_margins: Cut the blank space above and below each page
presets.split_tall_image: Too tall for the format: split into several images
presets.split_tall_image_hint:
Off: a long image is scaled down to the format's limit (JPG 65,500 px, WebP 16,383 px).
On: it keeps its size and is split between pages into several files (name_1, name_2, …).
presets.media_quality_hint:
When the new format can hold the codecs as they are (iPhone MOV → MP4), the video is only rewrapped.
No quality lost, HDR kept, done in seconds.
Small always re-encodes to make the file smaller.
presets.video_codec_hint:
H.264 plays everywhere.
HEVC files are about half the size and play on most phones, TVs and recent PCs.
AV1 is smaller still but slow to encode and needs a recent device.
A video already in the chosen codec is only rewrapped.
presets.hardware_encoding_hint:
Encodes H.264 and HEVC on the graphics chip.
Much faster and uses less power.
Slightly lower quality at the same file size.
Without a usable chip, the video is encoded as usual.
presets.combine: Put all files into one archive
presets.extract_note: Each archive is extracted into a folder of its own. Where it goes is set under Output.
presets.trace_note: Used when a picture (PNG, JPG, …) is traced into vector shapes.
presets.trace_detail_hint:
Low smooths the outlines and drops specks.
High follows the pixels closely and keeps small details.
presets.keep_dates_hint: Converted files get the created and modified dates of the original, so photos still sort by date.
presets.delete_confirm: Delete “{0}”? It will also be removed from every toolbar and group.
presets.select: Select a preset to edit it
theme.title: Theme
theme.reduce_motion_hint: Recommended for older PCs. Turns off transitions and animations.
engines.title: Conversion engines
engines.description:
Foldex picks the best available engine for each conversion.
When several can do the same job, the higher one wins.
engines.optional_description:
Large engines are only downloaded when you want them.
They are kept when Foldex updates and removed when you uninstall it.
engines.update_notice_title: Engines you installed have a new version
engines.all_description: Drag a card (or use its arrows) to change the order.
engines.lo_description:
LibreOffice can take over conversions it does more faithfully.
Without LibreOffice these switches change nothing.
engines.lo_slides_hint:
Slide backgrounds and shape positions come out as in PowerPoint.
Off: the built-in route, which can lose backgrounds or move shapes.
engines.lo_documents: Use LibreOffice for Word documents → PDF
engines.lo_documents_hint:
Laid out as in Word, including Chinese and Japanese punctuation rules.
Off: the built-in route.
engines.lo_sheets_hint:
Printed like Excel, with the print area, page setup and page breaks.
Off: the built-in route fits each sheet to the page width (page breaks kept).
engines.lo_hwp_hint:
Off by default: rhwp usually looks more like 한글.
Turn it on to compare when rhwp gets a document wrong (overlapping text, misplaced tables).
engines.package.libreoffice.name: LibreOffice (older and rare formats)
engines.package.libreoffice.description:
Needed for old or uncommon formats: DOC·PPT, OpenDocument presentations, WordPerfect, ClarisWorks·MacWrite, Apple Pages·Numbers·Keynote, Publisher·Visio and more.
Also saves as DOC·XLS·PPT·ODT·ODP·EMF and makes presentations → PDF more faithful.
Word, Excel, PowerPoint, PDF and HWP convert without it.
engines.package.pandoc.name: Pandoc (Markdown, LaTeX, Org and more)
engines.package.pandoc.description:
Adds Markdown and HTML ↔ ODT and RTF, DOCX → Markdown, and LaTeX, Org, AsciiDoc, Typst, Jupyter and other markup.
Also makes PPTX slides from Markdown.
Markdown and HTML → PDF, DOCX and HWPX work without it.
engines.package.ghostscript.name: Ghostscript (EPS and PostScript)
engines.package.ghostscript.description:
EPS, PS and older Illustrator files → PDF and images, PDF or SVG → EPS/PS.
SVG and PDF-compatible AI files convert without it.
engines.package.ffmpeg.name: FFmpeg (video and audio)
engines.package.ffmpeg.description:
Adds video and audio conversion, video → GIF or still image, sound from videos and GIF → MP4.
Only needed for video and audio.
engines.package.calibre.name: Calibre (Kindle and rare e-book formats)
engines.package.calibre.description:
Saves MOBI and AZW3 for Kindle and converts rare e-book formats (LIT, LRF, PDB, CHM…).
EPUB, MOBI, AZW3, FB2 and comics are read without it.
engines.package.system_required: Use a copy installed on this computer.
engines.guidance.macos: Install {0} for this Mac, then choose “Use my copy…” and select its program or .app folder.
engines.guidance.macos.ffmpeg:
Install it with Homebrew (brew install ffmpeg), then choose “Check again”.
Or choose “Use my copy…” and select its bin folder.
engines.guidance.macos.ghostscript:
Install it with Homebrew (brew install ghostscript), then choose “Check again”.
Or choose “Use my copy…” and select its bin folder.
engines.guidance.linux: Install {0} with your distribution’s package manager, then choose “Use my copy…” and select its program folder.
engines.guidance.linux.libreoffice:
Install it with your package manager (Ubuntu/Debian: sudo apt install libreoffice), then choose “Check again”.
Opening HWP also needs Java and the H2Orestart extension.
engines.guidance.linux.ghostscript: Install it with your package manager (Ubuntu/Debian: sudo apt install ghostscript), then choose “Check again”.
engines.guidance.windows:
Foldex has no download of {0} for this PC.
Choose “Use my copy…” and select an installed copy.
engines.remove_confirm: Remove {0}? You can download it again later.
engines.update_recommended:
Update recommended: this copy is {0}, Foldex is tested with {1}.
Most conversions still work.
engines.use_own_hint: Already have it? Pick its program and Foldex uses that instead of downloading its own.
engines.use_own_missing: That folder doesn't have everything Foldex needs: {0}.
engines.remove_failed: The engine is in use. Try again after the running conversions have finished.
feedback.notice_text:
If Foldex saves you time, a coffee keeps it going.
You can also follow my work on GitHub.
setup.title: Choose conversion engines
setup.description:
Images, PDF, Office documents, HWP, e-books, archives, fonts, CAD and 3D models already convert.
Download engines only for video and audio or rare formats.
setup.note: You can install or remove engines at any time in Settings → Engines.
watch.title: Watch folders
watch.description:
Files that land in these folders are converted while Foldex runs.
Downloads and copies wait until they're complete.
watch.originals_keep: Leave the original where it is
watch.originals_hint: Moving originals makes the folder work like an inbox, and files already waiting there when Foldex starts are converted too.
watch.include_placeholder: Type an extension or a name, then Enter (e.g. heic, scan_*)
watch.include_hint:
Leave empty to convert every file.
· heic → files ending in .heic
· scan → files with "scan" in the name
· * stands for any text, ? for one character (e.g. scan_*.jpg)
watch.name: Base name
watch.name_hint: The buttons add parts of the name. Leave it empty to use the preset's name.
watch.token.name: Original name
watch.rename_intro:
Set the base name, then change parts of it with rules if needed.
The preview shows the name each file will get.
watch.rename_no_steps: No changes. Pick one on the left or add one if you need it.
watch.rename_try_placeholder: Type a file name, e.g. IMG_0412.jpg
watch.include_matches: {0} file(s) in the folder match now
watch.recipes_hint: Double-click one (or press +) to add it as a rule, then change it if you like.
watch.preview_keep: The original stays where it is
watch.cli_hint: Also on the command line: foldex watch <folder> --to <format>
home.browse_hint: Pick files, then choose an action in the Quick panel.
pdf.title: PDF editor
pdf.subtitle: Open a PDF to edit its text, fill its form, sign it, rearrange its pages and add notes, highlights, shapes, page numbers or a watermark. The original file is never changed.
pdf.drop_hint: or open one from your computer
pdf.tip.insert: Insert pages from another PDF after the selection
pdf.tip.extract: Save the selected pages as a new PDF
pdf.cant_delete_all: A PDF needs at least one page. Keep one page, or close the document instead.
pdf.discard_message: The PDF you're editing has changes that aren't saved yet.
pdf.mark_hint: Drag the mark to move it. Pick a colour in the toolbar to change it. Highlights, underlines and strike-outs follow the text under them when saved.
pdf.on_save_hint: Applied to every page of the saved file.
pdf.remove_metadata: Remove title, author and other document info
tools.title: PDF tools
tools.subtitle: Work with whole PDF files. Results are saved as new files next to the originals, which stay as they are.
tools.merge_hint: Combine files in the order shown.
tools.merge_need_two: Add at least two PDFs to merge.
tools.split_hint: Each part becomes its own file next to the original.
tools.compress_hint: Makes pictures in the PDF smaller. Text and vector graphics stay sharp. A file that is already optimised may not get smaller.
tools.level.balanced_hint: For e-mail and uploads. Pictures stay clear on screen.
tools.level.small_hint: Smallest files. Pictures and scanned pages lose detail and may be hard to read when printed or zoomed.
tools.not_smaller: Already optimised: {0}, no smaller version found. The pages were kept as they are.
tools.security_hint: Protect a PDF with a password (AES-256), or save an unlocked copy of a PDF you know the password of. Foldex can't open PDFs without their password.
tools.current_password_hint: Only if the PDF already has one
tools.protect_need: Choose a PDF and enter the new password.
tools.unlock_need: Choose a PDF and enter its current password.
tools.text_hint: Saves the text of each PDF as a .txt file. This reads the text the PDF already contains; scanned pages are pictures, so run Recognise text (OCR) on them first.
tools.no_text: No text found. This may be a scanned PDF (pictures of pages), which needs OCR.
utils.title: File utilities
utils.subtitle: Find duplicates and space hogs, check what files really are, remove private metadata from pictures and rename many files at once. Scans only read your files.
utils.scan_hint: Nothing is deleted or moved. Use “Show” to open a file's folder and decide yourself.
utils.dup_summary: {0} group(s) of identical files (same SHA-256). Extra copies take {1}.
utils.mismatch_none: Every recognised file has a matching extension.
utils.mismatch_summary: {0} file(s) whose content doesn't match the extension. A program named like a document can be dangerous.
utils.compare_hint: Checks whether two files have exactly the same content (SHA-256).
utils.compare_same: Identical: both files have the same content.
utils.metadata_hint: Shows EXIF, GPS, IPTC and XMP data, and saves a copy without it. The copy is read back to check nothing is left.
utils.metadata_unreadable: This file can't be read as a picture ({0}).
utils.metadata_removed: Saved {0}: checked, no metadata left (colour profile kept).
utils.gps: This picture contains its GPS position: {0}, {1}
utils.rename_hint: Pattern tokens: {name}, {n} (counter), {date}, {ext}. Check the preview, then rename. Existing files are never overwritten.
utils.rename_confirm: Rename {0} file(s) as shown in the preview?
utils.rename_nothing: No file would get a new name.
tools.ocr_hint: Makes scanned PDFs searchable (the text is added invisibly over each page; the scan stays as it is) and saves the text of pictures as .txt. Uses the OCR built into Windows: nothing is uploaded or downloaded.
tools.ocr_no_language: Windows has no text recognition language installed. Add one in Windows Settings > Time & language > Language & region (language options > Optical character recognition).
tools.ocr_had_text: Every page already had text; the copy is unchanged.
tools.ocr_nothing: No text was recognised in this picture.
home.hero_sub: Convert, edit, compress, organize and automate — right on your PC.
home.supports: Images, documents, PDFs, e-books, audio, video and more
home.queue_empty: Conversions you start show their progress here.
home.panel_text: Hold your shortcut key while dragging files in Explorer: the Quick panel opens at your cursor. Drop the files on an action. Browse files and the drop zone above open it too.
home.recent_files_empty: Files you open or convert with Foldex show up here.
pdf.edit_text_turned: Text on turned pages can't be edited here yet. If you turned the page in Foldex, turn it back, edit, then turn it again.
pdf.edit_text_none: There's no editable text there. Scanned pages have none; run OCR in PDF tools, or add a text box.
pdf.edit_text_hint: This changes the page's own text. It's written in the closest installed font and checked after saving; if the page can't be changed safely, nothing is saved.
pdf.form_hint: Fill in the fields; they're saved into the PDF's own form.
pdf.cert_hint: A digital signature (PKCS#7, SHA-256) shows the PDF hasn't changed since. It can't be combined with a password.
pdf.cert_missing: Choose a certificate to sign with, or turn signing off.
pdf.cert_no_key: This certificate has no private key, so it can't sign.
pdf.cert_bad: “{0}” couldn't be opened. Check the certificate password.
pdf.unsaved_message: “{0}” has changes that aren't saved. If you don't save them, they're lost.
sig.title: Signature Studio
sig.hint: Type, draw or upload your signature. It's placed on the page as a picture you can move and resize; it isn't a certificate signature (use Sign with a certificate when saving for that).
sig.draw_here: Sign here with the mouse, a pen or a finger
sig.upload_hint: A photo or scan of your signature (PNG, JPEG, …, up to 25 MB). It's trimmed to the ink.
sig.preview_empty: Type, draw or upload a signature
sig.size_value: {0} × {1} pt on the page (aspect ratio kept)
pdf.edit_text_miss: Click directly on the line of text you want to change.
